x: J.V. Narlikar, with Fred Hoyle, propounded the Hoyle-Narlikar (conformal) theory of gravity, called a 'new theory of relativity' in exam books.

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer (Mains) General Studies &
s: Which Indian scientist has developed 'Cytotron' device. The device has been designated as the breakthrough device by the Centre for Devices and Radiological Health, a branch of the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) for treatment of liver, pancreatic and breast cancer treatment?
x: Dr Rajah Vijay Kumar (Scalene Cybernetics, Bengaluru) developed the Cytotron, given 'Breakthrough Device' status by the US FDA's CDRH.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
s: The Five Kingdom classification was proposed by
x: R.H. Whittaker proposed the Five Kingdom classification (1969); Linnaeus gave two kingdoms.

s: Under Palaeobotany, one studies –
x: Palaeobotany is the study of plant fossils; none of the options (animal fossils, algae, fungi) fits, so 'None of these'. Birbal Sahni is the father of Indian palaeobotany.

s: Who among the following popularised the use of embryological characters in taxonomy?
x: Panchanan Maheshwari, plant embryologist, popularised embryological characters in taxonomy; Birbal Sahni was a palaeobotanist.

s: The mutation theory of evolution was enunciated by
x: Hugo de Vries gave the mutation theory (evening primrose); Darwin gave natural selection and Lamarck the inheritance of acquired characters.

s: In which Tamilnadu town Nobel Laurater Venkatraman Ramakrishnan was born?
x: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan (Chemistry Nobel 2009) was born at Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu, in 1952.

s: In laboratory, who did the synthesis of DNA –
x: Har Gobind Khorana synthesised oligonucleotides and the first artificial gene in the laboratory; Miller did the origin-of-life experiment.

s: Hargovind Khurana is an international Authority in the field of:
x: Har Gobind Khorana's field was genetics/molecular biology: he helped decode the genetic code and made the first synthetic gene.

s: Which Indian scientist is recognised by ‘UNEP’ as Father of Economic Ecology ?
x: UNEP called M.S. Swaminathan the 'Father of Economic Ecology'.

s: Who among the following scientists has been conferred upon ‘Bharat Ratna’ for the year 2013 ?
x: C.N.R. Rao, the solid-state chemist, was named for the Bharat Ratna in Nov 2013 (with Sachin Tendulkar) and received it in Feb 2014.
